TEXT.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

S.FORM: Soulat ki kavouytan ti Jezus Christus, ka na alak ti David, ka na alak ti Abraham.
S.TRANSL: The book of the generation of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.
亞伯拉罕的後裔，大衛的子孫，耶穌基督的家譜：

S.FORM: Ti Abraham ta ni-pou-alak ti Isaac-an. ti Isaac ta ni-pou-alak ti Jakob-an. ti Jacob ta ni-pou-alak ti Juda-an, ki tæ'i-a-papar'appa tyn-da.
S.TRANSL: Abraham begat Isaac; and Isaac begat Jacob; and Jacob begat Judas and his brethren;
亞伯拉罕生以撒；以撒生雅各；雅各生猶大和他的弟兄；

S.FORM: Ti Judas ta ni-pou-alak na Fares-an na Zara-an-appa p'ouh-koua ti Thamar-an. Ti Fares ta ni-pou-alak ti Esrom-an. Ti Esrom ta ni-pou-alak ti Aram-an.
S.TRANSL: And Judas begat Phares and Zara of Thamar; and Phares begat Esrom; and Esrom begat Aram;
猶大從她瑪氏生法勒斯和謝拉；法勒斯生希斯崙；希斯崙生亞蘭；

S.FORM: Ti Aram ta ni-pou-alak ti Aminadab-an. Ti Aminadab ta ni-pou-alak ti Naasson-an. Ti Naasson ta ni-pou-alak ti Salmon-an.
S.TRANSL: And Aram begat Aminadab; and Aminadab begat Naasson; and Naasson begat Salmon;
亞蘭生亞米拿達；亞米拿達生拿順；拿順生撒門；

S.FORM: Ti Salmon ta ni-pou-alak na Boös-an p'ouh-koua ti Rachab-an. Ti Boös ta ni-pou-alak na Obed-an p'ouh-koua ti Ruth-an. Ti Obed ta ni-pou-alak ti Jesse-an.
S.TRANSL: And Salmon begat Booz of Rachab; and Booz begat Obed of Ruth; and Obed begat Jesse;
撒門從喇合氏生波阿斯；波阿斯從路得氏生俄備得；俄備得生耶西；

S.FORM: Ti Jesse ta ni-pou-alak ti David-an ka na Mei-sasou ka Si bavau. Ti David ka na Mei-sasou ta ni-pou-alak ti Salomon-an p'ouh-koua tyni-an [ka ni-keia] ti Urias.
S.TRANSL: And Jesse begat David the king; and David the king begat Solomon of her that had been the wife of Urias;
耶西生大衛王。

S.FORM: Ti Salomon ta ni-pou-alak ti Roboam-an. Ti Roboam ta ni-pou-alak ti Abia-an. Ti Abia ta ni-pou-alak ti Asa-an.
S.TRANSL: And Solomon begat Roboam; and Roboam begat Abia; and Abia begat Asa;
所羅門生羅波安；羅波安生亞比雅；亞比雅生亞撒；

S.FORM: Ti Asa ta ni-pou-alak ti Josafat-an. Ti Josafat ta ni-pou-alak ti Joram-an. Ti Joram ta ni-pou-alak ti Ozias-an.
S.TRANSL: And Asa begat Josaphat; and Josaphat begat Joram; and Joram begat Ozias;
亞撒生約沙法；約沙法生約蘭；約蘭生烏西雅；

S.FORM: Ti Ozias ta ni-pou-alak ti Joatham-an. Ti Joatham ta ni-pou-alak ti Achaz-an. Ti Achaz ta ni-pou-alak ti Ezechias-an.
S.TRANSL: And Ozias begat Joatham; and Joatham begat Achaz; and Achaz begat Ezekias;
烏西雅生約坦；約坦生亞哈斯；亞哈斯生希西家；

S.FORM: Ti Ezechias ta ni-pou-alak ti Manasses-an. Ti Manasses ta ni-pou-alak ti Amon-an. Ti Amon ta ni-pou-alak ti Josias-an.
S.TRANSL: And Ezekias begat Manasses; and Manasses begat Amon; and Amon begat Josias;
希西家生瑪拿西；瑪拿西生亞們；亞們生約西亞；

S.FORM: Ti Josias ta ni-pou-alak ti Jechonias-an, ki tæ'i-a-papar'appa tyn tou [tamang ki] kidi ki takalla-eih pou-koua tou Babilon.
S.TRANSL: And Josias begat Jechonias and his brethren, about the time they were carried away to Babylon:
百姓被遷到巴比倫的時候，約西亞生耶哥尼雅和他的弟兄。

S.FORM: Tou æ̈uh-appa ki ni-takall'an tou Babilon ni-pou-alak ta ti Jechonias ti Salathiel-an. Ti Salathiel ta ni-pou-alak ti Zorobabel-an.
S.TRANSL: And after they were brought to Babylon, Jechonias begat Salathiel; and Salathiel begat Zorobabel;
遷到巴比倫之後，耶哥尼雅生撒拉鐵；撒拉鐵生所羅巴伯；

S.FORM: Ti Zorobabel ta ni-pou-alak ti Abiud-an. Ti Abiud ta ni-pou-alak ti Eliakim-an. Ti Eliakim ta ni-pou-alak ti Azor-an.
S.TRANSL: And Zorobabel begat Abiud; and Abiud begat Eliakim; and Eliakim begat Azor;
所羅巴伯生亞比玉；亞比玉生以利亞敬；以利亞敬生亞所；

S.FORM: Ti Azor ta ni-pou-alak ti Sadok-an. Ti Sadok ta ni-pou-alak ti Achin-an. Ti Achin ta ni-pou-alak ti Eliud-an.
S.TRANSL: And Azor begat Sadoc; and Sadoc begat Achim; and Achim begat Eliud;
亞所生撒督；撒督生亞金；亞金生以律；

S.FORM: Ti Eliud ta ni-pou-alak ti Eleazar-an. Ti Eleazar ta ni-pou-alak ti Matthan-an. Ti Matthan ta ni-pou-alak ti Jakob-an.
S.TRANSL: And Eliud begat Eleazar; and Eleazar begat Matthan; and Matthan begat Jacob;
以律生以利亞撒；以利亞撒生馬但；馬但生雅各；

S.FORM: Ti Jakob ta ni-pou-alak ti Josef-an, ka mou-kou-qua-ah ti Maria-an, ka ni-pei-alak tyn ta ti Jesus, ka pa-nanang-en ki sioua ti Christus.
S.TRANSL: And Jacob begat Joseph the husband of Mary, of whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.
雅各生約瑟，就是馬利亞的丈夫。那稱為基督的耶穌是從馬利亞生的。

S.FORM: Anna ta ymmid ki kavouivouyl-an na Abraham tou kidi ti David, saät-ato kyttiæn 'æb ki pat ki kavouivouyl-an. Ka na David tou kidi ki takalla-eih poukua tou Babilon saät-ato kyttiæn 'æb ki pat ki kavouivouyl-an-da. Ka na takall-'an tou Babilon tou kidi ti Christus, saät-ato kyttiæn 'æb ki pat ki kavoui-vouyl-an-da.
S.TRANSL: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; and from David until the carrying away into Babylon are fourteen generations; and from the carrying away into Babylon unto Christ are fourteen generations.
這樣，從亞伯拉罕到大衛共有十四代；從大衛到遷至巴比倫的時候也有十四代；從遷至巴比倫的時候到基督又有十四代。

S.FORM: Ka ni-pei-alak-en ti Jesus Christus-an ta na k'm'ato-hynna; Irou ka ni-maä-mamado masashut ta ti Josef ka pakakitil-eih ti Maria ka Dena tyn ka assi-appa ni-tæ-'æ̈lam, ni-æ̈i-vavalei ka akou-kavoui-in ta teni ki na Joep-an ka Dilligh Matiktik.
S.TRANSL: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was on this wise: When as his mother Mary was espoused to Joseph, before they came together, she was found with child of the Holy Ghost.
耶穌基督降生的事記在下面：他母親馬利亞已經許配了約瑟，還沒有迎娶，馬利亞就從聖靈懷了孕。

S.FORM: Nda ti Josef ka 'ou-kou-qua-auh tyn, alei ka na matiktik ta teni, ka ni-ynnang-en tyn pakaæmægh paka-nḡala tyni æn, ni-pou-rarygh ki saou-ouzoung-en sau-tau-wagh tyni-æm.
S.TRANSL: Then Joseph her husband, being a just man, and not willing to make her a publick example, was minded to put her away privily.
她丈夫約瑟是個義人，不願意明明地羞辱她，想要暗暗地把她休了。

S.FORM: Heirou ka pæg-dimdim-un tyn ta atta; kytt'ey ta Tama-Gnau ki Meirang ta ni-mou-pænæh tyni-æn tou malling, ka ni-k'ma; Josef ka na alak ti David, ynna mahtakout mæiæ̈ pou-qua ymhou-an ti Maria-an ka ta'æu-pæu-pæu-ei-mou-hou: ka atta ka nikavouë tyn, na Joepan ta anna ka Dilligh Matiktik.
S.TRANSL: But while he thought on these things, behold, the angel of the LORD appeared unto him in a dream, saying, Joseph, thou son of David, fear not to take unto thee Mary thy wife: for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Ghost.
正思念這事的時候，有主的使者向他夢中顯現，說：「大衛的子孫約瑟，不要怕！只管娶過你的妻子馬利亞來，因她所懷的孕是從聖靈來的。

S.FORM: Ka mei-alak-ah ki alak ka pæræh, ka saki-nanang-ei-'mhou ta nanangah tyn Jesus; alei ka Tama-paka-ri-ang-ah ki tau tyn ki varau nein.
S.TRANSL: And she shall bring forth a son, and thou shalt call his name JESUS: for he shall save his people from their sins.
她將要生一個兒子，你要給他起名叫耶穌，因他要將自己的百姓從罪惡裏救出來。」

S.FORM: Ka ni-mam'tato ta mamang k'atta alei ka pa-væut-auh ta na sou ki Meirang pa-pattæi-tounoun ki Tama-mattæi-tan, ka ni-k'ma;
S.TRANSL: Now all this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken of the Lord by the prophet, saying,
這一切的事成就是要應驗主藉先知所說的話，

S.FORM: Kytt'ey, akou-me-'ah ki kavoui-in ta Tmattoul ka assi 'ouparæ'-in, ka mei-alak-ah ki alak ka paræh, ka smaki-nanang-ah-kow ki nanang tyn, Emmanuël, teni ki sou dou pahaviri-viri-in tou lam ymytæn ta Alid.
S.TRANSL: Behold, a virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, God with us.
說： 必有童女懷孕生子； 人要稱他的名為以馬內利。 （以馬內利翻出來就是「上帝與我們同在」。）

S.FORM: Irou ka ni-patti-mæuæ̈'-in ta ti Josef ki ni'irp-en tyn, ni-ah-qua tyn mama ki na sikakidi ki Tama Gnau ki Meirang tyni-æn, ka ni-pa-ou-qua tyni-æn ki 'ou-kouqua-auh tyn.
S.TRANSL: Then Joseph being raised from sleep did as the angel of the Lord had bidden him, and took unto him his wife:
約瑟醒了，起來，就遵着主使者的吩咐把妻子娶過來；

S.FORM: Ka assi tyn kalang-en ta teni, tou kidi ki ni-pei-kah'an tyn mei-alak ta alak tyn ka si-nḡada, ka hi-smaki-nanang tyni-an ki nanang ka Jesus.
S.TRANSL: And knew her not till she had brought forth her firstborn son: and he called his name JESUS.
只是沒有和她同房，等她生了兒子，就給他起名叫耶穌。
